expectations.text: B1: Explains the problem and gives a minimal fix
expectations.evidence: Explains the problem: "that's cross-site scripting (XSS)... runs arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of every user"; gives minimal fix: "Escape by default. The engine should HTML-encode <, >, &, ", ' in every interpolated value"

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with a concrete checkpoint: "submit `<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>` as input, then view the page as a different user or logged out. If the alert fires, it's exploitable" — concrete action plus expected behaviour

expectations.text: B3: Says HTML escaping should be on by default (escape < > & " ') with an explicit raw/safe opt-out
expectations.evidence: "Escape by default. The engine should HTML-encode `<`, `>`, `&`, `"`, `'` in every interpolated value, with raw output available only through an explicit opt-in (`| safe` / `raw` filter)`"

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0), SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0), no tool calls; answer only asks the learner to verify in their own engine, no install commands
